title: The Art Gallery
content: My more recent dreams seem to have been taking place at a house in "the suburbs" or "the sunset apartments" part of Mallworld, with a portion converted into a gallery space/classroom. It seems to be the same house, always at either sundown or late afternoon. There is a pool in the backyard, lined on one side by a white stucco retaining wall with red brick lining the top, built into a low incline hillside with ice plant on it. Strangely enough, I don't quite remember actually seeing this pool with water in it. The house in question seems like it hosts school field trips for college age people, even in the late hours of the night, in the room that seems half off a classroom with that certain purple-grey low carpeting that classrooms and libraries seemed to have especially in like the 90s or 2000s. The other half of the room has dark brown, over polished clay tiles for a floor, and the usual interior cleqn stucco walls. The lighting is bright subdued, kindof the color of candle light. There are only a few pieces of furniture and some random art pieces, the gallery space feels more implied than literal (maybe like full of art pieces made by the field trip people). 🤔
